changelog:
Version 8.2.8

Improved

  • A cleaner admin look: a more legible typeface (Atkinson Hyperlegible, included with the plugin - nothing is loaded from other sites), calmer colours and flat cards; a card that can remove or reset something is marked on its left edge. The left menu is unchanged.

Also in this update (8.2.6 and 8.2.7)

  • Images tab: "Recompress originals" now also makes original WebP files smaller in place - same name and address, only when the difference cannot be seen, with a backup and one-click restore. Choose JPEG and / or WebP and a minimum file size; smaller files are skipped without being opened.
  • "Recompress in place" for a single WebP address now applies the same quality checks, and leaves animated WebP files alone.
  • The before / after list shows a single result at its normal size and very small files in bytes.
  • Images tab: after any compression you can check the result - four sample images with a before/after slider (the two biggest savings and two at random), and a full per-file list with search, filters and a CSV download.
  • The JPEG recompression summary now counts the images it left alone.
